verdict.rationale: Salv publishes its own API reference backed by a downloadable OpenAPI definition, and that spec lets you pick a Sandbox (`demo`) or Production environment, which points toward trying requests against a safe target. Nothing shows the reference itself is interactive or has built-in runnable examples; running calls depends on importing the spec into Postman, an external tool that earns no credit. missing for 10: an in-browser 'try it' console in the reference, runnable code examples, explicit docs on interactive exploration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples

citations.quote: API definition to import into Postman can be downloaded at https://docs.salv.com/api/public.yaml
